sections.title: 1. General Provisions
paras: The Policy governs personal data processing between SP Shagidov F.T. (TIN 22102197700907, Bishkek, Usenbaeva St. 138a) — the Company, and Users of the websites: vokalo.kg, vokalo.ru, vokalo.online — the Website.
User — a legally capable individual aged 18+, wishing to order services, leave a comment, register, or use the site’s functionality.
Website — the Company’s web resources, including all domain levels.
Personal data — any information relating to an identifiable individual.
Processing of personal data — any operation with such data (collection, storage, systematization, transfer, destruction, etc.) with or without automation.

sections.title: 2. Scope and User Consent
paras: The Policy defines the procedure, conditions and principles of processing, Users’ rights, the Company’s obligations, and data protection measures.

The User accepts the Policy by entering their name, phone, and, if required, e‑mail into a Website form (e.g., submitting a request, comment, registration) and clicking ‘Submit’ or ‘Request a consultation’. If the User disagrees, they must immediately stop using the Website.

sections.title: 3. Personal Data the Company May Collect
paras: Possible data depend on the functionality used:
— surname, name;
— e‑mail;
— phone;
— identification data (user ID).
The User consents to processing (including transfer to third parties in provided cases) until the purposes are achieved or consent is withdrawn.
The Company follows: KR Law No. 58 dated 14.04.2008 ‘On Personal Information’; EU GDPR dated 27.04.2016; other acts of KR law.

sections.title: 4. Term and Withdrawal of Consent
paras: Consent is valid from provision until the purposes are achieved or until the User withdraws it.
To withdraw or clarify data, send a request to {{email}} with the subject ‘Clarify personal data’ or ‘Stop processing personal data’, indicating your e‑mail and request.

sections.title: 5. Purposes of Processing Personal Data
paras: The Company uses data for:
— user registration and identification;
— contacting regarding a request, including interaction with partners;
— consulting;
— creating an account/access to an account;
— information mailings;
— advertising, promotion of goods/services, content personalization;
— analysis and statistics of the Website;
— assessing advertising effectiveness;
— informing about promotions, discounts, offers;
— conducting marketing research (including via contractors);
— communication with partner banks regarding lending.

sections.title: 6. User Warranties
paras: The Company does not verify data accuracy but assumes that:
— the User is legally capable;
— data is accurate and up‑to‑date;
— the User understands that information they post may be accessible to others.

sections.title: 7. Processing Principles
paras: — lawfulness;
— limitation by specific purposes;
— avoiding mismatch between purposes and data scope;
— accuracy and relevance;
— destruction or depersonalization after achieving purposes or upon the User’s request.

sections.title: 8. Protection Measures
paras: The Company applies organizational and technical measures to protect data from unlawful access.
Processing is performed using databases within the Kyrgyz Republic, both automated and manual.

sections.title: 9. Transfer to Third Parties
paras: — Transfer to third parties is possible only with the User’s consent for performance of obligations.
— Partners must maintain confidentiality, ensure data protection, and not transfer data to others.

— The following does not violate the Policy: disclosure required by law/government; to partners under contract to perform obligations; anonymized disclosure for analysis, recommendations, advertising, and statistics.

sections.title: 10. Data Storage
paras: — On electronic and, if necessary, physical media.
— Until: the User deletes data via their account; destruction upon request; expiration of consent.
— Anonymized data may be stored after obligations are fulfilled.

sections.title: 11. Cookies and Analytics
paras: The Company uses cookies — data (IP, geolocation, browser, OS, device, date and time of access) transmitted automatically when using the Website. Cookies are used to remember settings and collect analytics.
Using the Website = consent to the collection and transfer of this data to third parties. The Company also receives IP and referral source but does not use them to identify a person.

sections.title: 12. User Rights
paras: The User has the right to:
— receive information about their data;
— request correction of inaccurate data (within 7 business days);
— request destruction of unlawfully processed data (within 7 days after confirmation);
— request cessation of processing upon withdrawal of consent, achievement of purpose, or detection of violations. Destruction — within 30 days; if impossible, blocking for up to 6 months.

sections.title: 13. Changes to the Policy
paras: The Company may make changes at any time. The current version is published on the Website. Continued use of the Website = consent to the new version. If the User disagrees, they must stop using the Website.
